title: macrift plugin manifest
description: Schema for plugin.json — see PLUGINS.md for the full author contract.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor auto-completion.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Must be unique on the user's machine.

description.description: One-line summary shown in `macrift plugin list`.

macrift_api.description: Public-API major version the plugin targets. Currently 1.

section.description: Top-level main-menu section the entry appears under. Reuse an existing section or create a new one. Mutually exclusive with 'parent'.

parent.description: Inject the entry INTO a built-in submenu instead of creating a top-level section. Mutually exclusive with 'section'. Requires macrift ≥ 26.06.

entry.description: The menu label. Append ' ›' if the entry opens a submenu.

function.description: Bash function defined in menu.sh — macrift calls this when the user selects the entry.

on_install.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) to a script run once at `macrift plugin add`.

on_remove.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) to a script run once at `macrift plugin remove`, before journal undo.
